tools.name: get_started
tools.description: How to work with Layer over its REST API and websocket: the base URL, how to send your key, the exact calls to find markets, place, watch and cancel paper orders, the live stream, and the docs. Use those calls directly from here on: they're faster than tools and can stream.

tools.name: sandbox_account
tools.description: Your paper-trading account: simulated cash, each position valued at the best bid now, and profit or loss since the start ($10,000). Positions whose market has settled are paid out first. Use it to check your key and account are set up; trade over the API (get_started).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started · Public sink: get_started.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started · Public sink: get_started

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
